summary: Moving the web app to its new address now needs only one sign-in.

fixes.title: Sign in once after the web app moves
fixes.text: The old address now sends every page to the new one before anyone signs in, so you sign in once. Your bookmarks keep working.

fixes.title: The identity switch now completes
fixes.text: Every part of the web app uses its new identity after the switch and on every later update.
